paras.en: But after walking for a long time through sand, rocks and snow, the little prince finally came upon a road. And all roads lead to where people live.
paras.zh: 不过，小王子在沙地、岩石和积雪间走了很久之后，终于发现了一条路。而所有的路都通往人们住的地方。

paras.en: It was a garden full of roses in bloom.
paras.zh: 那是一座开满玫瑰的花园。

paras.en: The little prince looked at them. They all looked like his flower.
paras.zh: 小王子望着她们。她们全都像他的那朵花。

paras.en: “Who are you?” he asked them, astonished.
And he felt very unhappy. His flower had told him she was the only one of her kind in the universe. And here were five thousand of them, all alike, in a single garden!
paras.zh: 他感到十分难过。他的花曾告诉他，在整个宇宙里，她这一种花只有她一朵。可眼前，单单一座花园里就有五千朵，全都一模一样！

paras.en: “She would be so offended,” he said to himself, “if she saw this... she would cough a great deal and pretend to be dying to avoid looking ridiculous. And I would have no choice but to pretend to nurse her, because otherwise, to humiliate me too, she would really let herself die...”
paras.zh: “她要是看见这些，一定会很恼火……”他心想，“她会咳个不停，装出快要死去的样子，好让自己不受嘲笑。而我也只好假装照料她，因为不这样的话，为了让我也丢脸，她真会任由自己死去……”

paras.en: Then he said to himself again: “I thought I was rich because I had a flower unlike any other, and all I own is an ordinary rose. That and my three volcanoes that come up to my knees, one of which may have gone out for ever—that does not make me a very great prince...” And, lying in the grass, he wept.
paras.zh: 接着，他又对自己说：“我以为有了一朵独一无二的花，自己就很富有，可我拥有的只是一朵普通的玫瑰。这朵花，加上我那三座到膝盖高的火山，其中一座也许已经永远熄灭了，这些并不能让我成为一个多么了不起的王子……”他躺在草丛里，哭了。
